svg.title: Gina RAG architecture map
svg.desc: Two trails: offline clean ingestion into a vector record contract v1, and online fail-closed retrieval through contract check, verifyAccess, live re-read with hash check, local sanitization, Trust Layer, LLM and approval harness. Every gate denies on doubt and writes one audit line.
svg.text: Who may read what, before any text reaches a model
Two trails. Every gate fails closed: an error, a timeout or a doubtful answer means deny. The index holds pointers and hashes, never the text.
ALLOW: passes to the next gate
data flow / live read from the org
the only source of served text
DENY · the chunk is dropped and the decision is logged
never chunk text, never field values
reason derived from detail in code
index row: pointer + fields + chunkHash, never the text
live: verifyAccess + re-read query the org
Policy comes from config, never from the index.
Any failure: fls_denied, before any org query.
Live latency: sf CLI transport, 20 samples. Leakage per independent oracle.
Prompt injection · blind corpus v2 (80 attacks / 80 benign) · 5 runs
median 80.0% (white tick) · false positives 0–1.3% · a layer, not a barrier
